description: Connected Components via label propagation on a random undirected sparse graph in CSR format. Each vertex starts with its own ID as label and iteratively updates to the minimum label among itself and its neighbors until convergence.

scaling_param.name: num_vertices
scaling_param.description: Number of vertices in the graph

non_scaling_params.name: max_iterations
non_scaling_params.description: Safety cap on label-propagation iterations; the solve early-exits at convergence (a few iterations), so this only bounds the worst case. Fixed at a value comfortably above convergence for all declared graph sizes — sweeping it would just produce identical runs (or, if set below convergence, a wrong result).

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Cold-cache calibration: when true, a vector-add warmer boosts the GPU clock and evicts the last-level cache before each timed iteration, so the kernel is measured cold-cache at a boosted clock (matching a cold-cache simulator). Set false for legacy warm-cache measurement.
